title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 5646 rto (AKU HT 58910)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja Stern, Tabitha Kraus, Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 58910

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 58910; AKU grapheme I0010 (AKU GR 326). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: I1 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 240. Occurrence: line 4; find place Theben; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 10.4 x 22.5 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 18. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja Stern, Tabitha Kraus, Ursula Verhoeven. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
